channel.title: Applied Stoic
channel.description: A quiet walk through Marcus Aurelius' Meditations, one book at a time. Two hosts read the ancient text the way it was meant to be read — not as inspiration, but as practice. Each episode pairs a passage with one thing to actually do with it. Stoicism, applied: character, resilience, and enduring what you can't control.
